_readme: Speaker attribution for the recordings (Kamadhenu). Keys are folder prefixes under incoming_audio/; the longest matching prefix wins. `consent` records the reciter's permission to train a synthetic voice from these recordings. Decided by the project lead on 6 Sep 2026. 6 Sep 2026, 6:35 pm IST: the lead confirmed that the Sumadhva Vijaya and Rāghavendra Vijaya recordings are also his — every reachable recording is 3BHU1. 6 Sep 2026, ~11:45 pm IST: nine more folders shared by the lead (Aṣṭādhyāyī pārāyaṇa, Brahmasūtra, Harikathāmṛtasāra, Seva Saṅgha videos, Vedavyāsa Gadya …) — same reciter.
